observations: Selecting a saved analysis adds a local report_list entry with report_id and name and a corresponding ui_config layout item.
Saving sends the complete report_list and ui_config through dashboard/edit.
report/setting edits an already attached association and then saves dashboard/edit.
report/delete removes an existing association by even_report.id; no independent link call appears in the frozen control flow.

local_boundary_contracts.capacity: reject when existing plus new report_list entries exceed 20, before preview or write
local_boundary_contracts.missing_or_inaccessible: reject unless every new report ID is present in the complete accessible saved-analysis catalog
local_boundary_contracts.whole_list_safety: read detail first, preserve all existing report and layout items, then merge new entries
local_boundary_contracts.readback: require the exact merged report set and preservation of every prior layout item

inference_not_claimed_as_production_prob: The 20-item, inaccessible-ID, idempotency, and failed-readback branches are contract tests; they were not forced against production.
The route census can miss dynamically assembled calls, but the frozen add-and-save control flow plus successful production dashboard/edit round-trip establishes choice A for this product action.
